what.title: Claude Code docs: Overview
what.quote: Claude Code is an AI-powered coding assistant that helps you build features, fix bugs, and automate development tasks.

loop.title: Claude Code docs: How Claude Code works
loop.quote: When you give Claude a task, it works through three phases: gather context, take action, and verify results.

tools.title: Claude Code docs: How Claude Code works
tools.quote: Without tools, Claude can only respond with text. With tools, Claude can act: read your code, edit files, run commands, search the web, and interact with external services.

account.title: Claude Code docs: Quickstart
account.quote: A Claude subscription (Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise), Claude Console account, or access through a supported cloud provider

install-windows.title: Claude Code docs: Quickstart
install-windows.quote: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.cmd -o install.cmd && install.cmd && del install.cmd

version.title: Claude Code docs: Quickstart
version.quote: When the installer finishes, open a new terminal window and run claude --version. A working installation prints a version number.

start.title: Claude Code docs: Quickstart
start.quote: Open your terminal in any project directory and start Claude Code:

login.title: Claude Code docs: Quickstart
login.quote: Claude Code prompts you to log in on first use.

reads.title: Claude Code docs: Quickstart
reads.quote: Claude Code reads your project files as needed. You don’t have to manually add context.

manual.title: Claude Code docs: Choose a permission mode
manual.quote: In Manual mode, Claude Code stops and asks you before most actions that edit files, run shell commands, or reach the network.

read-only.title: Claude Code docs: Configure permissions
read-only.quote: Claude Code recognizes a built-in set of Bash commands as read-only and runs them without a permission prompt in every mode

read-only-list.title: Claude Code docs: Configure permissions
read-only-list.quote: The set includes ls, cat, echo, pwd, head, tail, grep, find, wc, which, diff, stat, du, cd, and read-only forms of git.

prompt.title: Claude Code docs: Configure permissions
prompt.quote: A permission prompt shows what Claude is about to do, followed by your options.

edit-approval.title: Claude Code docs: Configure permissions
edit-approval.quote: A file-modification approval isn’t saved to the file: as the table shows, it lasts until the session ends.

bash-approval.title: Claude Code docs: Configure permissions
bash-approval.quote: When you choose “Yes, and don’t ask again” and the approval saves permanently, such as for a Bash command or a WebFetch domain, Claude Code saves the rule to .claude/settings.local.json at the root of the git repository, resolved through worktrees to the main checkout. The rule applies to future sessions anywhere in that repository

deny.title: Claude Code docs: Configure permissions
deny.quote: If you select No without a comment on a prompt from the main conversation, Claude Code stops the turn.

deny-comment.title: Claude Code docs: Configure permissions
deny-comment.quote: Claude Code sends your comment to Claude as the reason for the denial, and Claude continues working.

auto-default.title: Claude Code docs: Choose a permission mode
auto-default.quote: With Claude Code v2.1.283 or later, auto mode is the built-in starting permission mode for interactive terminal and VS Code sessions.

classifier.title: Claude Code docs: Choose a permission mode
classifier.quote: In auto mode, a second model, the classifier, reviews actions instead of you

manual-flag.title: Claude Code docs: Choose a permission mode
manual-flag.quote: The CLI accepts manual as an alias wherever you type the value, for example claude --permission-mode manual

shift-tab.title: Claude Code docs: Quickstart
shift-tab.quote: Press Shift+Tab at any time to switch the permission mode of the session you’re in.

enforced.title: Claude Code docs: Configure permissions
enforced.quote: Permission rules are enforced by Claude Code, not by the model.

esc.title: Claude Code docs: How Claude Code works
esc.quote: Press Esc to stop Claude immediately.

rewind.title: Claude Code docs: How Claude Code works
rewind.quote: Before Claude edits a file, it snapshots the current contents. If something goes wrong, press Esc twice to rewind to a previous state, or ask Claude to undo.

bash-untracked.title: Claude Code docs: Checkpointing
bash-untracked.quote: Checkpointing does not track files modified by Bash commands.

reads-free.title: Claude Code docs: Configure permissions
reads-free.quote: Read-only File reads, Grep No, within the working directory and additional directories
